create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS observe_application_projection (service TEXT NOT NULL,event_at INTEGER NOT NULL,event_id TEXT NOT NULL,operation TEXT NOT NULL,outcome TEXT NOT NULL,duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,http_status INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(service,event_at,event_id)) WITHOUT ROWID
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS observe_projection_insert AFTER INSERT ON observe_external_events BEGIN INSERT INTO observe_application_projection (service,event_at,event_id,operation,outcome,duration_ms,http_status) VALUES (NEW.service,NEW.event_at,NEW.event_id,json_extract(NEW.payload, '$.operation'),json_extract(NEW.payload, '$.outcome'),json_extract(NEW.payload, '$.durationMs'),CASE WHEN json_type(NEW.payload, '$.work.http_status') = 'integer' AND json_extract(NEW.payload, '$.work.http_status') BETWEEN 100 AND 599 THEN json_extract(NEW.payload, '$.work.http_status') ELSE 0 END); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS observe_projection_delete AFTER DELETE ON observe_external_events BEGIN DELETE FROM observe_application_projection WHERE service=OLD.service AND event_at=OLD.event_at AND event_id=OLD.event_id; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS observe_projection_update AFTER UPDATE ON observe_external_events BEGIN DELETE FROM observe_application_projection WHERE service=OLD.service AND event_at=OLD.event_at AND event_id=OLD.event_id; INSERT INTO observe_application_projection (service,event_at,event_id,operation,outcome,duration_ms,http_status) VALUES (NEW.service,NEW.event_at,NEW.event_id,json_extract(NEW.payload, '$.operation'),json_extract(NEW.payload, '$.outcome'),json_extract(NEW.payload, '$.durationMs'),CASE WHEN json_type(NEW.payload, '$.work.http_status') = 'integer' AND json_extract(NEW.payload, '$.work.http_status') BETWEEN 100 AND 599 THEN json_extract(NEW.payload, '$.work.http_status') ELSE 0 END); END
